title: Pan-Seared Tofu Bao
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Chinese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared tofu in a soft bao bun.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Meanwhile, toast the bao buns by grilling them for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Assemble the bao buns by placing the pan-seared tofu inside, and topping with soy sauce, green onions, and salt.
